rule: One integration feature may be active. Its parent record owns shared contracts and may admit at most four active mini-features. Every mini-feature has parent, seam, exclusive_owns, and merge_gate; it edits only those exact files. Integration dependencies must be done before activation. A reserved mini candidate becomes an indexed mini-feature only after the parent locks its contract and exact files. Parent owns may overlap earlier done features; active mini owns may not overlap each other or the parent shared-contract list.
